verses.text: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD, O my soul.

xrefs.text: Bless the LORD, all His works in all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!
Of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.
May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Hallelujah!
that they might keep His statutes and obey His laws. Hallelujah!

verses.text: I will praise the LORD all my life; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.

xrefs.text: So I will bless You as long as I live; in Your name I will lift my hands.
I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
A Psalm of praise. Of David. I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.
But I will always hope and will praise You more and more.

After this I looked and saw a multitude too large to count, from every nation and tribe and people and tongue, standing before the throne and before the Lamb. They were wearing white robes and holding palm branches in their hands.

verses.text: Put not your trust in princes, in mortal man, who cannot save.

xrefs.text: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.
This is what the LORD says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind, who makes mere flesh his strength and turns his heart from the LORD.
Put no more trust in man, who has only the breath in his nostrils. Of what account is he?
Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
But the Egyptians are men, not God; their horses are flesh, not spirit. When the LORD stretches out His hand, the helper will stumble, and the one he helps will fall; both will perish together.

verses.text: When his spirit departs, he returns to the ground; on that very day his plans perish.

xrefs.text: before the dust returns to the ground from which it came and the spirit returns to God who gave it.
When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.
Then the LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground and breathed the breath of life into his nostrils, and the man became a living being.
By the sweat of your brow you will eat your bread, until you return to the ground— because out of it were you taken. For dust you are, and to dust you shall return.”
Among the mature, however, we speak a message of wisdom— but not the wisdom of this age or of the rulers of this age, who are coming to nothing.

verses.text: Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God,

xrefs.text: But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in Him.
Blessed are the people of whom this is so; blessed are the people whose God is the LORD.
For You are my hope, O Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people He has chosen as His inheritance!
The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah

verses.text: the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them. He remains faithful forever.

xrefs.text: For in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth and the sea and all that is in them, but on the seventh day He rested. Therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and set it apart as holy.
And he said in a loud voice, “Fear God and give Him glory, because the hour of His judgment has come. Worship the One who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and the springs of waters.
For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
By His insight He made the heavens. His loving devotion endures forever.
In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

verses.text: He executes justice for the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets the prisoners free,

xrefs.text: The LORD executes righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.
God settles the lonely in families; He leads the prisoners out to prosperity, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me, because the LORD has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and freedom to the prisoners,
Do not rob a poor man because he is poor, and do not crush the afflicted at the gate,
As for you, because of the blood of My covenant, I will release your prisoners from the waterless pit.

verses.text: the LORD opens the eyes of the blind, the LORD lifts those who are weighed down, the LORD loves the righteous.

xrefs.text: For the LORD is righteous; He loves justice. The upright will see His face.
The LORD upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.

to open their eyes, so that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins and an inheritance among those sanctified by faith in Me.
And their eyes were opened. Jesus warned them sternly, “See that no one finds out about this!
Then the eyes of the blind will be opened and the ears of the deaf unstopped.

verses.text: The LORD protects foreigners; He sustains the fatherless and the widow, but the ways of the wicked He frustrates.

xrefs.text: A father of the fatherless and a defender of widows is God in His holy habitation.
He executes justice for the fatherless and widow, and He loves the foreigner, giving him food and clothing.
The LORD sustains the humble, but casts the wicked to the ground.

“Then I will draw near to you for judgment. And I will be a swift witness against sorcerers and adulterers and perjurers, against oppressors of the widowed and fatherless, and against those who defraud laborers of their wages and deny justice to the foreigner but do not fear Me,” says the LORD of Hosts.
You must not exploit or oppress a foreign resident, for you yourselves were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

verses.text: The LORD reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Hallelujah!

xrefs.text: The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations perish from His land.
The LORD will reign forever and ever!”
Then the seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and loud voices called out in heaven: “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ, and He will reign forever and ever.
Cry out and sing, O citizen of Zion, for great among you is the Holy One of Israel.”

And He was given dominion, glory, and kingship, that the people of every nation and language should serve Him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion that will not pass away, and His kingdom is one that will never be destroyed.
